Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started with Nurosym is pretty simple. Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a small amount of moisture on the tragus (the small bump on the front of your ear).
Clip the earpiece onto your left tragus, with the cable looping over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling sensation.
Use it for about 15–60 minutes per session, while relaxing or doing normal activities. 
Many people use it in the morning or split sessions between morning and evening. You can also use it while reading, working, meditating, or watching TV.
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually increase as it feels comfortable. The sensation should always feel pleasant, not uncomfortable. 
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before starting.
